subject: Request: Split invoicing + escrow account setup after ledger carve-out (Vista Works)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@vistaworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Split invoicing + escrow account setup after ledger carve-out (Vista Works)

Hi Maria —

Congrats again on the carve-out. To make sure invoicing doesn't block payment after the spin, Vista requested two changes: (1) invoices for product usage should be split 60/40 between Vista Works, Inc. (primary payer) and VW Services LLC (secondary payer) starting with the Aug invoices; and (2) they want an escrow account for disputed usage credits during the first 3 months post-close.

Can you confirm the legal names, billing addresses, and the exact remit instructions we should use for each entity? For the escrow we usually need a bank account name, routing/wire instructions, and the party who will have authority to release funds. We can draft an Amendment to the MSA and route it for signature (DocuSign) once you confirm.

Quick items we need from you to avoid invoice rejections:
- Full legal entity names and billing addresses for both payers
- W-9 for US entity (or W-8 if non-US tax resident)
- Bank wiring details for normal payments and escrow account
- Whether VW Services LLC should receive a separate invoice or a sub-line on the Vista Works invoice (our billing system supports both)

I attached a quick sample invoice and a drafting checklist. Once you confirm, Ben (payments) and Monica (tax) will handle the setup and I’ll send the amendment to sign.

Thanks —
Tessa
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0191

Attachments: Vista_works_invoice_sample.pdf
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@vistaworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@vistaworks.com, treasury@oakbank.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoicing + escrow account setup after ledger carve-out (Vista Works)

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for reaching out and for the sample invoice — helpful. Confirming:

1) Legal names and addresses:
   - Vista Works, Inc. (primary payer)
     210 Harbor Drive, Suite 400
     San Diego, CA 92101

   - VW Services LLC (secondary payer)
     12 Commerce Row
     Wilmington, DE 19801

2) For tax docs: attaching our W-9 for Vista Works, Inc. VW Services LLC is a US LLC and will provide a separate W-9 by EOD Friday.

3) Escrow: our treasury team (copied) can provision an escrow account at OakBank. They will own the account and name a release approver. For initial setup we need: the proposed escrow bank name and whether Redwood can be an administrator on the account for release instructions (read-only vs active).

4) Invoicing preference: We prefer a single invoice with a breakdown (primary line charged to Vista Works, Inc.; secondary line billed to VW Services LLC). That keeps one payment flow while preserving internal chargebacks.

Can you send the proposed Amendment and the exact language we should provide to OakBank for the escrow agreement? Once we have that, treasury will respond with bank onboarding steps.

Best,
Maria Garcia
Head of Finance, Vista Works

Attachments: W9_Vista_USA.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@vistaworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoicing + escrow account setup after ledger carve-out (Vista Works)

Thanks Maria — great, that all helps.

Ben — can your team provision the escrow wording? We typically propose the following for OakBank to start the paperwork:
- Escrow account title: "Vista Works Escrow - Redwood Inference"
- Purpose: hold disputed customer credits for platform usage disputes between 2028-08-01 and 2028-10-31
- Release conditions: mutual written authorization from Vista Works Head of Finance AND Redwood Director of Customer Finance, or adjudication per Section 8.3 of the MSA
- Initial funding: hold 60% of the average monthly invoice for the last 3 months as calculated by Redwood (estimated $180k)

Monica — confirm tax intake: we will accept the two W-9s. If VW Services has EU VAT implications later (they may be an intermediary for EU customers), we’ll surface W-8/W-9 needs then.

I’ve drafted Amendment #1 (attached) that:
- Adds VW Services LLC as an invoiced entity (sub-line option)
- Adds an Escrow Addendum with release conditions as above
- Adds remit instructions sections for both entities

I will send the DocuSign link once you confirm changes to the amendment language. If you prefer separate invoices instead of sub-lines, call that out and we will switch the format.

Next steps:
- Vista: confirm approval of escrow wording and remit preference
- Redwood: Ben to generate the OakBank escrow request template; Monica to intake W-9s and update tax profile; I’ll prepare DocuSign packet

Tessa
Director, Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Amendment_1_DocuSign.pdf (draft)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@vistaworks.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: treasury@oakbank.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Split invoicing + escrow account setup after ledger carve-out (Vista Works)

Hi Maria / team —

OakBank treasury here. Quick operational notes from our side to speed onboarding:

1) For the escrow account we need: full account title, EIN for Vista Works Escrow (if Vista prefers an entity-tied escrow), and designated signers (name, title, DOB, SSN last 4 for US signers) for KYC.

2) Wire vs ACH: Redwood supports ACH for standard invoice payments (USD ACH), but the escrow initial funding should be sent via wire to ensure availability. Please provide Wire routing (ABA), account number, and beneficiary name exactly as it should appear.

3) DocuSign and bank: OakBank requires the executed Amendment PDF before finalizing the escrow. If you want us to pre-populate the bank onboarding form, send the final Amendment and the sample invoice mapping you’ll use.

Maria — once we receive the W-9 for VW Services and confirm the designated signers, we can provision the escrow account in ~4 business days.

Ben Carter
Manager, Payments & Treasury Ops
Redwood Inference
